description: ALB targets return HTTP health-check responses outside their configured matcher
rationale: AWS DescribeTargetHealth reports Target.ResponseCodeMismatch. Preserve the target group's health-check protocol, port, path and matcher for diagnosis. This is a verified mismatch symptom, not proof of a wrong health-check path or a connectivity exploit.
remediation: Inspect the health-check path, matcher, protocol, application authentication/redirects and actual target responses, then adjust the application or ALB target group appropriately.
